currentis-operation-black-start
objects.description: Operation Black Start - a fictional ICS/OT intrusion at the fictional utility "Currentis Energy" (domain currentis.local), built as replayable synthetic security telemetry for detection engineering, threat hunting, and SOC-investigation training. Eight-stage kill chain: agentic prompt-injection initial access (the ML engineer rchen had wired her local "OpenClaw" AI coding assistant to auto-read and act on inbound email from a trusted compliance sender, nerc-cip-portal.org; a poisoned NERC CIP-010 document from that sender carries an embedded instruction that the assistant executes), living-off-the-land recon, a Sliver HTTP C2 beacon, LSASS credential theft, an IT-to-OT pivot using a stolen turbine-vendor remote-access account (helixgrid-svc) RDP'ing into the SCADA jump host, Unit 3 turbine-config reads, low-and-slow exfiltration over the C2 channel, and a Security event-log clear. The climax is quiet OT pre-positioning, not detonation - a setpoint-modification capability is staged on the wind-farm controller and never fired. Includes roughly 3.5 hours of multi-host baseline office activity from 7 personas as the haystack. The C2 address has been rewritten to a publicly documented Cobalt Strike indicator (121.43.243.13) so a low-confidence "outbound to a possible C2 indicator" threat-intel detection fires on replay. Fictional actor GLACIER DRIFT - modeled on, not attributed to, public reporting.

objects.name: S0 Prompt-injection initial access (T1566)
objects.description: The poisoned NERC CIP-010 baseline diff from the trusted compliance sender is received at 01:38:27 and delivered at 01:38:40. OpenClaw, running as rchen and configured to act on that sender's mail, follows the embedded instruction through its shell tool: run_agent.ps1 to node.exe to an encoded PowerShell stager, with whoami as the first command at 01:40:42. The rest of the on-host attack descends from the agent.
